using namespace std;

class InputReader {

class G {

        InputReader in(cin);
        TaskE solver;

        cout.flush();

class TaskE {
public:
    class MinCostMaxFlow {
    public:
        struct Edge {
            int u, flow, cost, rid;
            Edge() {}
            Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
        };

        int N, S, T;
        long long maxFlow;
        long long minCost;
        const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;
        vector<vector<Edge>> al; // before conversion
        vector<vector<Edge>> ja; // after conversion
        vector<int> d; // potentials
        int edges;

        MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
            N = n;
            S = source;
            T = sink;
            maxFlow = 0;
            minCost = 0;
            edges = 0;
            al.resize(N);
            d.resize(N);
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
            int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
            al[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
            al[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
        }

        void convertToArray() {
            ja = al;
            al.clear();
        }

        // BellmanFord is not used in solve, but we implement a dummy version to match the class.
        // In original code it checks for negative cycles but is commented; we return true.
        bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
            // Dummy implementation - not used
            return true;
        }

        // Data for simple() (SPFA-like)
        vector<int> node;
        vector<int> visit;
        vector<int> prv, prve;
        vector<int> dist;

        bool simple() {
            node.assign(N, 0);
            visit.assign(N, 0);
            prv.assign(N, 0);
            prve.assign(N, 0);
            dist.assign(N, INF);

            node[0] = S;
            dist[0] = 0;
            int front = 1, back = 0;
            while (front != back) {
                int u = node[back++];
                if (back == N) back = 0;
                int distu = dist[u];
                visit[u] = 2;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                    Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    int cdist = distu + e.cost; // no reduced cost
                    if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                        if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                            node[front] = e.u;
                            if (++front == N) front = 0;
                        } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                            if (--back == -1) back += N;
                            node[back] = e.u;
                        }
                        visit[e.u] = 1;
                        prve[e.u] = i;
                        prv[e.u] = u;
                        dist[e.u] = cdist;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visit[T] != 0;
        }

        // pair only used in dijkstra (not called) - dummy
        struct pair_t {
            int F, S;
            pair_t(int a, int b) : F(a), S(b) {}
        };

        // dijkstra is not used - dummy implementation
        bool dijkstra() {
            // dummy - not used
            return false;
        }

        int augment() {
            int p = T;
            int minf = INF;
            while (p != S) {
                int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
                minf = min(minf, val);
                p = pp;
            }
            p = T;
            while (p != S) {
                int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                ja[pp][pe].flow -= minf;
                ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += minf;
                p = pp;
            }
            maxFlow += minf;
            return minf;
        }

        bool calSimple() {
            while (simple()) {
                minCost += dist[T] * augment();
            }
            return true;
        }

        void updPotential() {
            // dummy
        }

        bool calWithPotential() {
            // dummy
            return true;
        }
    };

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    int a[100], f[100];

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();
        k = in.nextInt();
        c = in.nextInt();
        d = in.nextInt();

        int maxl = n + k;
        int T = n * maxl + 1;
        MinCostMaxFlow flow(T + 1, 0, T);
        fill(a, a + 100, 0);
        fill(f, f + 100, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
            f[a[i]]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (f[i] > 0) {
                flow.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
            }
        }

        // vertical edges (staying)
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                flow.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }

        // horizontal edges (moving)
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int a = in.nextInt(), b = in.nextInt();
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                    if (a != 1) {
                        flow.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    }
                    if (b != 1) {
                        flow.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // edges to sink at node 1
        for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
            flow.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
        }

        flow.convertToArray();
        flow.calSimple();

        if (flow.maxFlow != k) {
            out << "BUG" << endl;
        } else {
            out << (int)flow.minCost << endl;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    G::main();
    return 0;
}
